author: Kekoxixon
body:
Hi! Im Keko_ and i wanna join an Avicus team.

First of all, im new in this server, i have been playing OCN a lot (and im still playing) but i wanna play Avicus also ;)

Age: 15

Experience: All my experience is in OCN so i will tell you some tournament that i played.

- Breaking Core: StonersPvP

- King Of The Wool: Dixtorsion (5th)

- Guardians of the Wool: LogisticGamers (Lost in 2nd round against Sigma)

- Conquest: LogisticGamers (Lost in 1st round against TheRaptors)

- House of Cores: Sirius (18th)

- Age of Ares: NaVi (top 16)

Position: Rusher (i can also cannon but only if we really need it)

I will only accept teams with Ts3 or Mumble cause i don't use Skype.

I can speak Spanish and English.

My youtube channel (here i have some videos of me playing): https://www.youtube.com/user/KekorulesYT

If you want more information ask me  ;D 

My Skype: kekoxixon (i will only accept the ones who i want)
